weapons.name: M4A1 Carbine
weapons.source_note: Rifling RH 1 turn in 7 in (177.8 mm). The manual does not state barrel length or groove count.

weapons.name: M16A4 Rifle
weapons.source_note: Rifling RH 1 turn in 7 in (177.8 mm). The manual does not state barrel length or groove count.

weapons.name: M16A2 Rifle
weapons.source_note: Rifling RH 1 turn in 7 in (177.8 mm). The manual does not state barrel length or groove count.

weapons.name: M14 Rifle
weapons.source_note: Barrel length 22 in (558.8 mm) from the tabulated data. The manual does not state the rifling twist. Twist not verified.

weapons.name: M24 Sniper Weapon System
weapons.source_note: Barrel rifling 5 radial with 1 turn in 11.2 in (284.48 mm). The manual does not state barrel length.

weapons.name: M40A5 Sniper Rifle
weapons.source_note: Rifling 1 turn in 12 in (304.8 mm), right hand. Barrel length 24 in (609.6 mm). The manual covers the M40A3 and M40A5.

weapons.name: M110 SASS
weapons.source_note: 20 in barrel, 5 grooves, right-hand twist 1 turn in 11 in (279.4 mm). The manual also covers the Mk 11 Mod 0.

weapons.name: SR-25
weapons.source_note: KAC catalog lists the SR-25 20 in 5R match barrel with a 1:11 twist (279.4 mm). Other SR-25 variants are listed at 16 in with the same 1:11 twist.

weapons.name: M249 SAW
weapons.source_note: Barrel assembly 520 mm (20.50 in). Rifling twist 1 turn in 7 in (177.8 mm).

weapons.name: M240B Machine Gun
weapons.source_note: The M240 operator and field maintenance manuals held here do not state the rifling twist. Not verified.

weapons.name: M60 Machine Gun
weapons.source_note: Ordnance tabulated data: number of lands 4, right-hand twist one turn in 12 in (304.8 mm). The manual does not state barrel length.

weapons.name: M107 / M82 Long Range Sniper Rifle
weapons.source_note: M107A1 barrel 29 in (737 mm) with a 1:15 in twist (381 mm). The M107A1 CQ variant has a 20.6 in barrel with the same twist.

weapons.name: Mk18 Close Quarters Battle Rifle
weapons.source_note: No held primary or manufacturer document states the twist. Not verified.

weapons.name: Mk12 Special Purpose Rifle
weapons.source_note: No held primary or manufacturer document states the twist. Not verified.

weapons.name: HK416
weapons.source_note: Barrel 14.5 in (368 mm), 6 grooves, right-hand twist 178 mm. Other barrel lengths 10, 16.5 and 20 in share the twist.

weapons.name: HK417
weapons.source_note: Barrel 16 in (406 mm), 4 grooves, right-hand twist 280 mm. Other barrel lengths 12 and 20 in share the twist.

weapons.name: G3 Battle Rifle
weapons.source_note: Barrel 450 mm (17.71 in). Length of twist 305 mm (12.00 in), right hand, 4 grooves.

weapons.name: G36 Rifle
weapons.source_note: G36 barrel 480 mm (G36K 318 mm, G36C 228 mm). Groove and land profile right-hand twist 178 mm. The sheet does not state the groove count.

weapons.name: MP5 Submachine Gun
weapons.source_note: Barrel 8.85 in (225 mm). 6 grooves, right hand, 1 turn in 9.86 in (250.4 mm).

weapons.name: MP7 Personal Defence Weapon
weapons.source_note: Barrel 180 mm. The bore is a polygonal profile with 6 twist lines, right hand. The sheet does not state a pitch in mm. Twist not verified.

weapons.name: MG3 Machine Gun
weapons.source_note: The held MG3 manual states a barrel with 4 grooves but does not state the twist. Not verified.

weapons.name: MG4 Machine Gun
weapons.source_note: Groove and land profile 6 grooves, right-hand twist. The sheet does not state the pitch in mm or the barrel length. Twist not verified.

weapons.name: Steyr AUG
weapons.source_note: AUG A3 SA: barrel 16 in (407 mm), 6 grooves, 1 turn right in 9 in (228.6 mm). The classic A1 rifle barrel is 508 mm with the same twist.

weapons.name: SIG SG 550 / SG 551
weapons.source_note: 6 grooves. Rifling 1 turn in 10 in (254 mm) for the SG550-1; the SG550-2 export variant is 1 turn in 7 in (178 mm). Barrel 16.02 in (407 mm) for the USA model.

weapons.name: P226 Pistol
weapons.source_note: Barrel 112 mm. Rifling lead 250 mm for the 9 mm chambering. The manual does not state the groove count.

weapons.name: FAMAS
weapons.source_note: F1: barrel 488 mm, 3 grooves, right-hand pitch 12 in (304.8 mm). The manual gives an optional 9 in (228.6 mm) pitch for the SS109/G2.

weapons.name: L85A2 Rifle
weapons.source_note: L98A2 cadet rifle (L85A2): 6 grooves, pitch 180 mm, 1 turn right hand. The document does not state barrel length.

weapons.name: L1A1 Self-Loading Rifle
weapons.source_note: The L1A1 is the UK inch-pattern FN FAL. The FN FAL manual states 4 grooves, right hand, pitch 1 in 305 mm (11.9 in, 304.8 mm).

weapons.name: AK-47 Assault Rifle
weapons.source_note: The held USMC AK-47 operator manual and the AK armourer manual do not state the twist. Not verified.

weapons.name: AKM Assault Rifle
weapons.source_note: No held primary document states the twist. Not verified.

weapons.name: AK-74 Assault Rifle
weapons.source_note: The held USMC AK-74 operator manual does not state the twist. Not verified.

weapons.name: AKS-74U Carbine
weapons.source_note: No held primary document states the twist. Not verified.

weapons.name: RPK Light Machine Gun
weapons.source_note: The held RPK operator manual does not state the twist. Not verified.

weapons.name: PKM General Purpose Machine Gun
weapons.source_note: The held PKM operator manual does not state the twist. Not verified.

weapons.name: SVD Dragunov Sniper Rifle
weapons.source_note: The Russian technical manual states 4 grooves but does not state the twist. Not verified.

weapons.name: VSS Vintorez / 9A-91
weapons.source_note: No held primary or manufacturer document states the twist. Not verified.

weapons.name: FN SCAR-L
weapons.source_note: The FN datasheet states a 14.5 in (368 mm) barrel but does not state the twist. Twist not verified.

weapons.name: FN SCAR-H
weapons.source_note: The FN datasheet states a 16 in (406 mm) barrel but does not state the twist. Twist not verified.

weapons.name: FN FAL
weapons.source_note: Barrel 533 mm (21 in). Rifling 4 grooves, right hand, pitch 1 in 305 mm (11.9 in).

weapons.name: Uzi Submachine Gun
weapons.source_note: Rifling right hand, 4 grooves, 1 turn in 254 mm (10 in). The manual does not state the barrel length for the SMG.

weapons.name: FN P90
weapons.source_note: No held primary or manufacturer document states the twist. Not verified.

weapons.name: Glock 17 Pistol
weapons.source_note: Barrel length 114 mm (4.49 in). Barrel rifling right hand, length of twist 250 mm (9.84 in). The barrel is polygonal so no groove count is given.

weapons.name: M1911A1 Pistol
weapons.source_note: Number of grooves 6. Rifling left hand, one turn in 16 in (406.4 mm). The manual does not state barrel length.

weapons.name: Beretta 92 / M9 Pistol
weapons.source_note: Barrel 125 mm (4.92 in). Rifling right hand, 6 grooves, pitch 250 mm (1 turn in 10 in). The groove count was checked against the page image.

weapons.name: KRISS Vector
weapons.source_note: CRB barrel 16 in (406 mm), 1:16 in right-hand twist (406.4 mm) in .45 ACP. The 9 mm model is 1:10 in. The manual does not state the groove count.

weapons.name: SIG MPX
weapons.source_note: No held primary or manufacturer document states the twist. Not verified.

weapons.name: SIG MCX
weapons.source_note: No held primary or manufacturer document states the twist. Not verified.

weapons.name: QBU-88 Designated Marksman Rifle
weapons.source_note: No held primary or manufacturer document states the twist. Not verified.

weapons.name: QBZ-95 Assault Rifle
weapons.source_note: No held primary or manufacturer document states the twist. Not verified.

weapons.name: .338 Lapua Magnum rifle (AWM / AXMC)
weapons.source_note: AXMC in .338 LM: 27 in barrel (685.8 mm), 1 in 9.35 in twist (237.49 mm). A 20 in barrel is also offered with the same twist. The datasheet does not state the groove count.

weapons.name: 6.5mm Creedmoor service rifle
weapons.source_note: No adopted 6.5mm Creedmoor service rifle and no held primary or manufacturer document could be verified for the twist. Not verified.
